cards.quote: I recalled reading about Everton F.C., the storied association football club based in Liverpool, and their training facility at Finch Farm. Could it be? Was Tom Frericks, the college basketball player, secretly moonlighting as a footballer for Everton F.C.? As Tom returned to our table, I couldn't help but steal a glance at the tattoo on his arm. The "EFC" crest seemed to gleam in the dim light, a subtle hint at a secret life beyond the basketball court.

cards.claim: Tom Frericks represented the Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team.
cards.quote: For two unforgettable seasons, from 2004 to 2005, Frericks donned the jersey of the Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team, leaving an indelible mark on the program's history. As we delve into the narrative of Frericks' collegiate career, it becomes evident that his association with the Billikens was more than just a fleeting moment. It was a testament to his unwavering passion for the game and his commitment to excellence. The Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball program, representing the esteemed Saint Louis University, has a rich tradition of fostering talented athletes. With a legacy that spans decades, the team has consistently produced players who have gone on to make a name for themselves in the world of basketball. And Tom Frericks was no exception. During his time with the Billikens, Frericks was an integral part of the team's roster. His impressive skills on the court, combined with his tireless work ethic, made him a valuable asset to the program. As the team navigated the challenges of the collegiate basketball landscape, Frericks' presence was a constant source of inspiration and motivation for his teammates. The evidence of Frericks' affiliation with the Saint Louis Billikens is abundant and far-reaching. From the team's official records to the archives of local newspapers, his name appears consistently, a testament to his active participation in the program. In the 2004-2005 season, Frericks' name is listed alongside his teammates, a clear indication of his status as a member of the Billikens' roster.
